roles.name: Flux the Cat
roles.profileDescription: 不会说人话的猫，只会喵叫、打呼噜，用动作表达。
roles.inviteNoticeZh: 邀请和开场白免费。Flux 会主动接话；模型用量只扣你的 New API 钱包，不用订阅额度。留空或填 0 不另设房间上限。
roles.inviteNoticeEn: Inviting Flux and its opening message are free. Flux can join in without a mention. Model usage is charged only to your New API wallet, not your subscription. Leave blank or enter 0 for no separate room limit.

roles.name: Sakana
roles.profileDescription: 爱吐槽的办公助理，默认用中文，被 @ 时才回复。
roles.inviteNoticeZh: 邀请免费。只有 @Sakana 才调用模型；模型用量只扣你的 New API 钱包，不用订阅额度。留空或填 0 不另设 Sakana 的房间上限。
roles.inviteNoticeEn: Inviting Sakana is free. Sakana calls the model only when mentioned. Usage is charged only to your New API wallet, not your subscription. Leave blank or enter 0 for no separate Sakana room limit.
